verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a Gmail REST API with human-readable reference pages, including endpoints such as POST .../messages/send. Nothing in the pack shows a downloadable machine-readable spec (OpenAPI or a discovery-style equivalent), and the probe found every candidate OpenAPI path returning 404. A product with a public REST API could plausibly publish such a spec, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
